name: Frameow
tagline: AI-generated digital cat portraits and wallpapers from your photo.
description:
Frameow turns cat photos into AI-generated digital portraits and phone wallpapers. Cat owners choose from curated styles, add a photo they own or have permission to use, and create a personalized image without writing prompts. Sign-in is required before uploading and generating.

The free plan includes 20 credits each monthly cycle, one saved cat profile and watermark-free downloads. Unused free credits expire at the end of the cycle. Optional paid subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide more credits. Users can preview the result and download the digital image. AI results and processing times vary. Frameow does not ship prints or frames or enlarge images; users can arrange their own printing after checking the downloaded file dimensions.
